name: 95030 · Los Gatos, CA
findings: ZIP 95030 (Los Gatos) has 96 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95030 (Los Gatos) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
